trustBoundaries.reaches: Binds immutable quote token, wrapper, treasury and implementation; code/decimals checks do not independently establish canonical identity (Factory L65-L92; Raffle L155-L166).

trustBoundaries.actor: Untrusted sponsor and arbitrary prize contract
trustBoundaries.reaches: Configuration, registry publication, callback activation and token-reported escrow checks; factory guard is instance-local (Factory L97-L148; Raffle L176-L206,L416-L431).

trustBoundaries.entrypoint: buyEntries -> quote transfer -> safe mint -> receiver callback
trustBoundaries.reaches: Quote boundary, cumulative range/value ledger and ERC721 ownership; callback can use unguarded inherited transfers (Raffle L209-L237,L497-L502; ERC721 L115-L136,L287-L290).

trustBoundaries.actor: Untrusted ticket owner and approved operators
trustBoundaries.reaches: Delegated transfer authority and destination screening in all lifecycle states; only current owners can redeem/refund (ERC721 L93-L136,L383-L418; Raffle L320-L321,L359-L360,L497-L502).

trustBoundaries.actor: Permissionless native fee payer and trusted canonical wrapper
trustBoundaries.reaches: Native overpayment refund, request identity and deadline gates; wrapper origin is authenticated, service/randomness properties remain external assumptions (Raffle L240-L273,L509-L524; consumer base L76-L107).
Timeout-dependent liability reclassification or historical winning-range allocation; neither operation transfers assets (Raffle L276-L306,L533-L558).
Live-owner check, claim/ticket consumption and external prize or quote payout; atomic failure restores the transaction (Raffle L309-L372).

trustBoundaries.actor: Permissionless release caller; untrusted fixed recipients
trustBoundaries.reaches: Separate allocated liabilities or prize claim paid to configured recipients; caller cannot select recipient (Raffle L375-L407).
Registry, historic ranges, accounting, ownership and fee views; empty-calldata direct native transfer reverts (orientation entrypoints; Raffle L170-L173,L436-L486; Factory L25-L54).

fragilityClusters.why: Creation registers before the arbitrary prize call, while activation checks callback identities and the factory later checks reported owner/status. Source establishes those reports, with prize honesty separate (Factory L123-L134; Raffle L421-L430).

Range allocation and lifetime counters persist through transfers/burns; settlement needs range membership while claims need live ownership. Receiver callbacks can change owner before buyEntries returns (Raffle L226-L235,L320-L325,L359-L364,L451-L455,L533-L558).
Two price queries, in-flight suppression, returned request ID, timestamp narrowing, strict callback/request cutoffs and inclusive timeout transitions interact (Raffle L240-L301,L458-L465,L509-L524).

fragilityClusters.area: Nominal liabilities and independent asset claims
fragilityClusters.why: One pot becomes either refund liability or terminal allocations, then separately consumed balances; actual backing depends on external quote semantics and prize reports (Raffle L296-L299,L323-L405,L468-L475,L533-L566).

Initial configuration, mint/transfer and quote payouts reuse a current code/registry policy, while burns skip screening and inherited ERC721 transfers are outside the shared guarded entrypoints (Raffle L187-L195,L497-L502,L564-L567,L593-L605).
